chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch.81: The Snow Jade Dragon Descends on the Battlefield
chapter_meta_description: Wang Tong's legendary flying dagger fails when Xiao Chen's Keke eggshell saves him. A Snow Jade Dragon erupts, burying Yan Qingcheng and scattering the cultivators.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch.81: The Snow Jade Dragon Descends
og_description: Xiao Chen survives the unbeatable dagger, then faces a dragon that shatters mountains. Yan Qingcheng is buried alive in an avalanche.
twitter_description: Xiao Chen's Keke eggshell blocks the Little Li Flying Dagger. Snow Jade Dragon forces all to flee. Yan Qingcheng is lost in snow.
